scope: Bounded static source-access discovery from newly generated standalone Python

contracts.inspection: Literal payload extraction and checked whole-module AST fingerprint; no target import, execution or eval
contracts.identity: Payload checksum included in syntax fingerprint; stale execution/metadata edits require retranslation; no authenticity or security guarantee
contracts.inputs: Required/conditional read-before-definite-write candidates with type, logical address and physical/Python locations; no invented values
contracts.flow: Structured branches, widened loops, bounded constant FOR expansion, SELECT, internal routine aliases/private arguments and return merges
contracts.storage: Independent aggregate leaves, direct ports, numeric/string/position banks and static own-program GET_VAR/SET_VAR paths
contracts.context: Service/address requirements are separate from initial values; selected leaves need whole-root context restoration and manual values
contracts.gaps: Dynamic access, unsupported effects/schemas, external linkage, nonstructured flow, locals/derived missing values and limits remain explicit
contracts.complete: Supported bounded source-access coverage only; no successful execution, termination, host callback completeness or native equivalence claim
contracts.publication: New output only, protected target aliases, UTF-8 LF JSON; full report instances excluded from public Git

future: Automatic root-value population and parameter editor
